commits.subject: fix(cloud-agent): disable auto-stop to prevent agent unavailability
commits.body:
Fly.io machines were becoming unavailable after periods of inactivity
because auto_stop_machines was set to "stop" with min_machines_running=0.

Changes:
- Set auto_stop_machines=false to keep machines running
- Set min_machines_running=1 to ensure availability

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.author: StanGirard
commits.subject: feat(plugin): add 247-orchestrator plugin for multi-agent orchestration
commits.body:
Add a Claude Code plugin that enables spawning and controlling parallel
claude -p sessions from a master session.

Features:
- New plugin structure in packages/plugin-247/ with commands, agents, skills
- Spawn endpoint POST /api/sessions/spawn for launching claude -p sessions
- Output capture GET /api/sessions/:name/output with tmux scrollback
- Input sending POST /api/sessions/:name/input for session interaction
- DB schema v9 with spawn fields (parent_session, task_id, exit_code, etc.)
- MCP server with tools: spawn_session, list_sessions, get_output, send_input
- Shared types for orchestration (SpawnSessionRequest/Response, TaskStatus)
- marketplace.json for custom marketplace distribution

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

+## Multi-Agent Orchestration Plugin
+
+247 includes a Claude Code plugin for spawning and controlling parallel Claude sessions.
+
+### Installation
+
+```bash
+# Add the 247 marketplace
+claude marketplace add https://github.com/quivr/247
+
+# Install the plugin
+claude plugin install 247-orchestrator
+```
+
+Or install locally for development:
+
+```bash
+claude plugin install ./packages/plugin-247 --scope local
+```
+
+### Commands
+
+| Command              | Description                    |
+| -------------------- | ------------------------------ |
+| `/247:spawn <task>`  | Spawn a new background session |
+| `/247:status [name]` | Check session status           |
+| `/247:sessions`      | List all active sessions       |
